48	/**
49	 * Validates the authenticated user owns the given studio.
50	 * Returns { userId, supabase } on success, or { error } on failure.
51	 */
52	async function requireStudioOwnership(studioId: string): Promise<
53	  | { userId: string; supabase: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>; error?: never }
54	  | { error: ActionResult<never>; userId?: never; supabase?: never }
55	> {
56	  const supabase = await createClient()
57	
58	  const {
59	    data: { user },
60	    error: authError,
61	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
62

64	    return { error: { ok: false, error: 'Not authenticated.' } }
65	  }

67	  const { data: member, error: memberError } = await supabase
68	    .from('studio_members')

75	    return { error: { ok: false, error: 'Studio not found.' } }
76	  }
77	
78	  if (member.role !== 'owner') {
79	    return { error: { ok: false, error: 'Only the studio owner can complete onboarding.' } }
80	  }

82	  return { userId: user.id, supabase }
